jena: Canary on v3-quant8 showed weird A/B variance — need a decision on decay vs rollback. Posting quick numbers below.
ashwin: Can you paste the dashboard link or a short summary?
jena: Summary: EQ (exact-match) down ~2.3% vs baseline, p95 latency +12%, error-rate ~unchanged. 5% traffic, 2h run.
maya: Ran bootstrap significance: p=0.04 on EQ drop. Signal concentrated on prompts > 2048 tokens (long-context).
ashwin: Ok — so we need gating that is context-aware. Otherwise short prompts will mask the problem. Suggest rule: if quality_delta <= -1.5% && latency_p95_increase >= 10% -> trigger rollback. Otherwise start decay (reduce traffic by 50% over 30m) and re-evaluate.
sam: Draft config for discussion:
```
canary_policy: {
  threshold_quality_drop: 0.015,
  latency_p95_increase: 0.10,
  significance_pvalue: 0.05,
  traffic_allocation: 0.05,
  decay: {
    mode: "staged",
    reduce_by: 0.5,
    window_minutes: 30
  },
  immediate_rollback_if: {
    quality_drop_gt: 0.03,
    error_rate_pct_gt: 0.005
  }
}
```
jena: Prefer staged fallback unless quality_drop > 3% OR error_rate > 0.5% — then immediate rollback. Also add an exclusion for short prompts in the primary quality metric.
maya: Agreed. Add a "context-aware" metric slice: only evaluate EQ on prompts > 1024 tokens for this canary to avoid noisy short-prompt signal.
infra-bot: Deploybot: canary v3-quant8 started at 1717894300, traffic=5% :rocket:
ashwin: :thumbsup: I'll update the rollout config with the staged decay + context slice and run a synthetic long-context benchmark (20k tokens workload). ETA ~20m.
jena: If synthetic reproduces the skew we'll auto-fallback per immediate rules. If not, continue slow ramp to 20% and monitor the long-context slice closely.
